::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 21st [1871?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Winchester City Council, Historic Resources Centre LH803.4
:::

My dear [Miss Bramston](people/person_198.qmd)[^1]
I shall have much pleasure in dining with you next Thursday   It is lucky the [lectures](organizations/other_240.qmd) are over today, or it would not have been easy to manage it[^2]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Mary Bramston is recorded in the 1871 census living in Winchester with her brother [John](people/person_196.qmd) who was a master at [Winchester College](organizations/other_50.qmd).
[^2]: The *Englishwoman’s Review* 1 (January 1870), 27 notes, 'Lectures to ladies on English literature are to be given by Professor Morley, at Winchester in the autumn.'
